faqs.question: How is sandwich panel pricing calculated?
faqs.answer: Price is calculated per m² and depends on panel thickness, metal thickness, core type, order volume, RAL color, and delivery address. Exact pricing is provided via an individual quote — ask by phone.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order?
faqs.answer: There is no hard minimum. Orders of 30 m² and above are accepted as standard. Smaller volumes can be produced individually when needed.

faqs.question: How long does an order take?
faqs.answer: Standard orders take 3–7 business days; large or custom orders take 7–15 business days.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. We deliver across Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Central Asia. Delivery is free on orders of 400 m² and above.

faqs.question: Do you offer installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional installation is available across Uzbekistan by agreement.

faqs.question: What is the difference between EPS and Basalt?
faqs.answer: EPS (polystyrene) is an economical, effective core for warehouses, hangars, poultry houses, and general construction. Basalt (mineral wool) is recommended for high fire-risk industry, plants, chemicals, and administrative buildings.

faqs.question: Do you provide a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every product ships with a quality passport and an official warranty of up to 10 years.

faqs.question: Will a specialist visit the site?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our specialists visit the site for free measurement and calculation. Free professional consultation is also available.

faqs.question: Can you produce custom lengths to order?
faqs.answer: Yes. Panel length is made to the customer’s requirements. Wall panel width is 1000 or 1200 mm; roof panel width is 1000 mm.

faqs.question: How does payment work?
faqs.answer: Payment terms are agreed based on order volume and the contract.

devor-paneli.title: Wall sandwich panel
devor-paneli.subtitle: A high-quality, energy-efficient, reliable wall solution — for hangars, warehouses, workshops, and retail buildings.
devor-paneli.structureNote: EPS or basalt core between double-sided pre-painted steel (polyester). The Z-Lock system reduces air and moisture permeability.

tom-paneli.title: Roof sandwich panel
tom-paneli.subtitle: A roof panel built for load and weather — for warehouses, hangars, and production buildings.
tom-paneli.structureNote: The outer ribbed steel sheet manages water runoff. The inner sheet is flat; EPS or basalt insulation sits in between.

z-lock.title: Z-Lock sandwich panel
z-lock.subtitle: Z-Lock — a sandwich panel system with a tight joint. Fast install, strong sealing, and reduced heat loss.
z-lock.profile: Z-shaped lock joint · primarily for wall panels
z-lock.structureNote: Z-profile locks along the panel edges engage firmly. Versus classic flat-lock, this means tighter fit, fewer cold bridges, and faster installation.
